description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and configurations for an OpenWrt-based system on the i.MX Cortex-A9 architecture. It defines environment setup, image validation, upgrade procedures, and configurations tailored for specific hardware boards.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata verification for specific board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is compatible with the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the detected hardware board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies board-specific configuration files prior to upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the system before performing the upgrade, such as invoking specific pre-upgrade scripts.
